jlcpcb.title: Main circuit board (factory-assembled)
jlcpcb.disclaimer: Reference boards from this design were built and checked. Your fab run is still its own order — review stock and part orientation before you pay. No partnership with JLCPCB.
steps: Go to jlcpcb.com and sign in or create an account.
Click Order Now and upload the Board layout file (Gerber).
Enable PCB Assembly at the bottom of the page (so they solder the parts for you).
Set PCBA Type: Standard, Assembly Side: Both sides, then continue.
Continue again and upload the Parts list file (BOM) and Placement file (CPL).
Review stock and part orientation, then finish checkout.

items.label: Wi-Fi brain · Waveshare ESP32-C3-Zero
items.notes: Needs two 1×9 2.54 mm male pin headers (often in the box), or buy ESP32-C3-Zero-M with pins already fitted.
items.blurb: Tiny computer board. Pins often in the box; or get the version with pins attached (Zero-M).

items.label: Hobby micro servo
items.notes: Buy five of one model. Do not mix. No single store SKU.
items.blurb: Five identical motors — arms and body. Do not mix models.

items.label: Speaker · Adafruit Mini Oval 8 Ω 1 W
items.blurb: Tiny oval speaker; fits in the head.

items.label: Face screen · Waveshare 0.91″ OLED
items.blurb: Small OLED for the robot face (128×32).

lanes.title: Fasteners and power
lanes.lede: Everyday bits — a mixed screw pack is fine.

items.label: Small screws + nuts (M2)
items.notes: Pan/button-head for plastic: 8× M2×4, 27× M2×8 (BottomCover heads ≤ 4.0 mm × 2.0 mm), 15× M2×16, 6× M2 nuts. Linked 1080-pc kit covers M2×4–×25 + nuts.
items.blurb: M2 lengths ~4 / 8 / 16 mm + nuts; assortment pack OK.

items.label: Strong USB power + data USB-C cable
items.tips: You need both: (1) any wall charger that can supply at least 2 A at 5 V — a weak 1 A phone brick browns out the robot; (2) a USB-C cable that carries data, not charge-only. The Buy link is one known-good data cable; pick any ≥2 A supply you already trust.
items.notes: Need both: ≥2 A supply (1 A phone charger browns out) and a data USB-C cable (charge-only fails flash/serial).
items.blurb: ≥2 A charger plus a data USB-C cable (not charge-only).

items.label: Extension wires (male–female ~7–12 cm)
items.notes: One pack (≥10 wires). Any M–F length ~7–12 cm works. Adafruit 1953 is 3″ (~7.5 cm) — fine. Extend OLED and servo leads when stock cables are short.
items.blurb: Extend short screen or servo leads (~7–12 cm M–F).
